title: Resolving the Interstellar Medium in Ultraluminous Infrared QSO Hosts with ALMA
question: What are the distribution, kinematics and dynamical masses of the molecular gas (CO(1-0)) and 3-mm continuum in local ultraluminous IR QSO hosts, and how do BH accretion and star formation relate?

data.sensitivity: 0.4-0.9 mJy/beam per 25 km/s channel; continuum 30-78 uJy

what.value: Black hole masses and AGN bolometric luminosities

evidence.quote: virial black hole masses from (cite: hao05) using H$\beta$ broad emission line and $\lambda L_{\lambda,5100\textup{\AA}}$ measurements.

what.value: Far-IR luminosities from IRAS 60 and 100 um flux densities and single-dish CO

evidence.quote: the far-IR luminosities were calculated based on the flux densities measured at IRAS 60 $\mu$m and 100 $\mu$m (cite: xia12)

what.value: Archival ALMA CO(1-0) of IRAS F11119+3257 at 2.8 arcsec

evidence.quote: we combined our high-resolution CO data with the archival ALMA CO data ($\sim$ 2$''$ .8 resolution) observed by (cite: veilleux17)

recipe.method: clean in MFS for continuum; uvcontsub then clean for cubes; robust 2.0 for analysis

recipe.goal: Measure CO fluxes, redshifts and line widths; compare with IRAM 30m
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to spectra from circular apertures or >=2 sigma regions; compared to single-dish
uv-plane model fitting of CO (circular + elliptical Gaussian) and continuum (circular Gaussian)
3D tilted-ring models with inclination from axis ratio; V_rot and sigma at turnover radius

recipe.goal: Derive CO luminosity and gas mass
recipe.method: Solomon+97 L'CO formula; M_H2 = alpha_CO L'CO
rotating disk Mdyn=2.3e5 v^2 R (v=0.75 FWHM/sin i if no model); virial 5 sigma^2 R/G for irregular
assumptions: R = 0.75 x CO FWHM major axis

recipe.goal: Compare BH accretion rate with SFR
recipe.method: Macc = Lbol/(eta c^2); SFR from FIR or CO-predicted IR; log-linear bisector fit
assumptions: eta=0.1; Eddington accretion when Lbol unavailable for high-z

evidence.quote: $\sim$ 1.2$-$7.0 kpc with a median of 3.2 kpc
$\sim$ 0.4$-$1.0 kpc with a median of 0.6 kpc
is in the range of 4$-$6 for the three galaxies
with a median value of 0.22$\pm$0.04 for IR QSOs
The median value of $\dot{M}_{\rm acc}$/SFR is **$6.0\times10^{-3}$** for IR QSOs
our interferometric data typically recover $\sim$ 80% of the observed single-dish flux
ranging from 0.02% to 0.36% with a median value of 0.08%

not_stated_but_needed: Clean threshold, mask, cell and image size
Whether archive pipeline products or re-run scripts were used
3D-BAROLO configuration (ring geometry, fixed parameters, fitting options)
Aperture and velocity ranges for CO integration beyond Fig 2
UVMULTIFIT initial guesses and fit settings
Details of the log-linear bisector fit to Macc vs SFR and the high-z compilation
score_reason: Single public project and standard CASA steps, but imaging and BAROLO details are missing and the SFR-accretion part relies on external compilations.
rediscovery_reason: Archive data from one project; the recipe (imaging, uv size fits, dynamical mass formulae) is mostly specified and the results are numeric.
